title: One full rotation
text: If we start at the point C, and add $$2\pi$$ radians, you will do one full rotation and end up back where you started.

title: Extrapolate
text: You can complete multiple full rotations and end up at the same location. This tells us that $$\pi, $$ $$3\pi$$, $$5\pi$$, $$7\pi$$, ... are all equivalent radian measures.

title: Change directions
text: You can also rotate in the opposite direction, and end up back at the same point. This means that the angles are ..., $$-5\pi$$, $$-3\pi$$, -pi, pi, $$3\pi$$, $$5\pi$$, ... also written as $$\pi+2n\pi=(2n+1)\pi$$ where $$n$$ is any integer.
